story_facts.headline: Verifying Rust cryptography in SymCrypt, from standards to code
story_facts.plain_language_summary: Cryptographic code supports vital protections in modern computing systems. Learn how a new method helps verify code as developers write it while preserving speed and adaptability as it gets implemented and evolves. The post Verifying Rust cryptography in SymCrypt, from standards to code appeared first on Microsoft Research .
